lines.t: (Verse 1 - build up)
I went chasing after shadows,
Hoping they would fill my soul.
I walked the roads that led to nothing,
Till I forgot what made me whole.
The world said, “Run, we’ll make you stronger,”
But left me empty, cold, undone.
I lost myself in distant places,
Far from the heart of the Holy One.
(Pre-chorus)
And when the silence cut like winter,
My heart broke open in the night.
I knew the warmth I’d been missing
Was found only in His light.
(Chorus)
So I’m returning—
Back to the arms that never close.
Back to the truth my spirit knows.
Back to the Love that calls me still,
The One who heals, restores, and will.
I’m returning—
Though I wandered far away,
He runs to meet me where I lay.
The world gave nothing…
But The Messiah gave me everything.
(Verse 2)
I traded peace for empty promise,
I chased the wind, I chased the night.
But every dream without His presence
Faded before the morning light.
My hands were full of broken answers,
My heart was heavy with my shame.
Yet even then He whispered softly—
“I’ve never left, I’m still the same.”
(Pre-chorus)
And when I feared I’d gone too far,
He lifted up my eyes to see:
The path I thought was closed forever
Was still wide open—calling me.
(Chorus)
So I’m returning—
Back to the arms that never close.
Back to the truth my spirit knows.
Back to the Love that calls me still,
The One who heals, restores, and will.
I’m returning—
Though I wandered far away,
He runs to meet me where I lay.
The world gave nothing…
But The Messiah gave me everything.
I hear Him calling on the wind,
“My child, come home, begin again.”
No shame too deep, no night too long,
His mercy sings a healing song.
He wraps me in His endless grace,
I feel His heartbeat in this place.
The world cast stones—
But He gave love.
A gift that only comes from above.
(Final chorus)
So I’m returning—
Back to the arms that never close.
Back to the truth my spirit knows.
Back to the Love that calls me still,
The One who heals, restores, and will.
I’m returning—
Though I wandered far away,
He runs to meet me where I lay.
The world gave nothing…
But The Messiah gave me everything.
And now forever—
I’m finally home.
